description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Technical Enablement Operations Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Senior Director of GTM Enablement - Shared Services in the Business Operations and Shared Services department. In this role, you will support enablement processes for our technical sellers by driving project timelines, managing resources, and ensuring the delivery of high-impact training materials. You will partner with cross-functional teams to create effective learning solutions that equip our internal and partner technical sellers with the knowledge and skills needed to position products successfully.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Plan and oversee technical events, including Tech Summit, Tech Up, SC1, and Office Hours, while supporting the technical enablement intake process
  • Manage technical content within the CMS and drive content documentation, surveys, timelines, and communication plans for course launches
  • Collaborate with technical content developers, LMS operations, and marketing to track content priorities, resources, and key deliverables
  • Facilitate cross-functional relationships by leading weekly planning meetings, resolving bottlenecks, and keeping stakeholders informed on project progress
  • Identify innovative learning technologies and industry trends to continuously improve and scale training product growth

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner by fueling your bias for action with a passion for the mission, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver who actively seeks out challenges and is energized by finding solutions that deliver the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces a challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback with candor, clarity, and respect.
  • You are driven by innovation and possess a deep curiosity for how things work, constantly seeking better, more secure, and scalable ways to accelerate transformation.
  • You think at scale by connecting your day-to-day work to the larger company mission, building solutions and processes designed to support a high-growth, global organization.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 5+ years of experience in project management for learning deliverables and instructional design
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong proficiency in project management tools such as Asana or Smartsheet, as well as Microsoft Office and Google Suite
  • Proven ability to build relationships, collaborate across a geographically dispersed team, and navigate ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong business acumen with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs
  • Proficiency in various learning technology platforms and rapid development tools
  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Advanced expertise in meeting facilitation, priority management, and scaling operational processes
